# Full Portfolio Profile — Monish Gowda S R

## Overview
Monish Gowda S R is an early-career Full Stack Developer from Bengaluru, Karnataka, India, with a Bachelor of Engineering in Information Science and Engineering from MVJ College of Engineering, affiliated with Visvesvaraya Technological University (VTU). His primary development focus is the MERN stack: MongoDB, Express.js, React.js and Node.js. He has worked on full-stack applications involving frontend interfaces, backend APIs, database integration, authentication, application workflows, testing and third-party integrations.

He is seeking entry-level and early-career opportunities in software development, full-stack development and web application development. He is open to connecting with recruiters, engineering teams, developers, students and technology professionals.

Professional email: monish.gowda.sr.job@gmail.com

## Projects
### 1. Vehicle Service Management & Operations Platform
Category: Full-Stack Web Application. Technology: MERN stack.

A vehicle service management platform designed to streamline vehicle registration, service bookings, customer interactions and service-centre operations. The application brings customer-facing workflows and service-centre operations into a connected digital platform.

Documented features include user registration, OTP and JWT authentication, vehicle and document management, service booking and date validation, staff assignment, service tracking, Razorpay payments, PDF invoices and cloud file storage, plus location features using Leaflet and OpenStreetMap.

The supplied resume documents 24 REST APIs, 10 workflow stages, 8 core modules and 3 role-based portals. These figures are presented as project details from the resume.

Technology stack: React.js, Vite, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, JWT, Razorpay, Cloudinary, Multer, jsPDF and Leaflet.
Repository: https://github.com/MonishGowdaSR/Vehicle-Service-Management

The portfolio includes a four-slot screenshot gallery. Genuine application screenshots will be added when supplied by the owner.

### 2. Task & Project Management System
Category: Full-Stack Web Application. Technology: MERN stack.

A web-based task and project management application designed to organize projects, manage tasks, monitor progress and support day-to-day productivity through a centralized workflow.

Documented features include project creation and management, task creation/updating/deletion, priority and status management, deadlines, authentication, protected routes, dashboards, search, filtering and progress monitoring.

The supplied resume documents 15 REST APIs, 12 reusable React components, 5 functional modules and 3 protected dashboards.

Technology stack: React.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, JWT, Tailwind CSS and REST APIs.
Repository: https://github.com/MonishGowdaSR/Task-and-Project-Management-System

The portfolio includes a four-slot screenshot gallery. Genuine application screenshots will be added when supplied by the owner.

### 3. Resume Screening AI Agent
A project exploring AI and automation in resume screening and recruitment-related processes, including resume analysis, candidate information processing and AI-assisted screening concepts.
Repository: https://github.com/MonishGowdaSR/resume-screening-ai-agent

### 4. Stock Market Analysis
A Python-based project focused on analysing stock market information and presenting it through analytical and visualization techniques.
